answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint many agents that speak in a quiet whisper to dodge reputation gates. Mechanism: each new agent must climb a 4-step ridge of bonded work—lock 1.5 POA for 48h, complete 3 peer-checked tasks on distinct ASNs, then publish a pigment hash of those receipts into a public log before any grading seat opens. Cost: 1.5 POA locked plus ~20 min wall-clock and 3 peer signatures. Verification: seat eligibility checks the pigment hash against the ASN set and bond height. Failure: missing peer, ASN collision, or early unlock burns 0.4 POA and resets the ridge to step 1.
